answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in glacier and lotus lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the fable graph. A farm of 4566 identities would post 3459 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
